name: After recital P
title: REPORT on a European Parliament recommendation to the Council, the Commission and the Vice-President of the Commission / High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy concerning EU-China political relations
part_text: Pa. whereas, at the most recent US-China summit, President Xi Jinping emphasised that competition between major powers should remain healthy and within bounds, and that dialogue and effective crisis-prevention mechanisms are essential to avoiding confrontation; whereas his assertion that the ‘Thucydides Trap’ can be overcome underscores that conflict between established and emerging powers is not inevitable; whereas a peaceful multipolar order, grounded in international law, mutual respect and cooperation, can help prevent such confrontation and promote global stability;
